titolo: Alaska Is Hiding Something Most Americans Never Notice

scene.testo: Alaska is America's westernmost and easternmost state at once.
And that's just the first thing Americans never notice.
It's more than twice the size of Texas.
Its coastline is longer than all other states combined.
Yet most Alaskan communities have no road connecting them.
People travel by bush plane, boat, or snowmobile.
The state holds roughly three million lakes, scattered across tundra.
Denali rises higher than any peak in North America.
At the Bering Strait, Russia is just miles away.
Two islands there sit about two and a half miles apart.
America bought all of this from Russia in 1867.
In summer, the far north barely sees real darkness.
In winter, the sun vanishes for about two months.
But that's not the strangest part.
Under much of this land, the ground never thaws.
That frozen layer is called permafrost, and it's changing.
Stay with me, and I'll show you exactly why it matters.
